name: Felshina
source:
Felshina after her death become sub-god that was bound to the labyrinth under the Voromia Academy.
And thus keeps protecting the students who enter the labyrinth so they wouldn't die there like she did. Only selected few people in the Voromia Academy knows that Fiine is Felshina.
